### Closure Evidence (independently verified; no test execution available — review limit)

AD11, §4, T2(i)(iii), AC7(iv), §9(15) all use the post-work wording; no residual pre-work placement. - **CR7-2 closed.** Retirement baseline is captured inside the hook after `retireLiveOwner` (`projection.go:894`; `cleanupRetiredOwner` `:878-892` → `replaceProjectionLocked(owner,nil)` + registry delta). AC7(v), T2(iii), §9(15), §10 C1 agree; the oracle is satisfiable (retirement's own delta precedes the baseline) and remains falsifiable via the expected `catalog_changed` result.
- **CR7-3 closed.** Verified exactly: `resolveBinding` call `:623` (`:625` = unknown-name return), `contributeOperation` `:689`, `wantOperations` `log_test.go:424-432` with `reflect.DeepEqual` at `:432`. No residual `:693-708` / `:428-433`.

### Issues
[LOW][stale-citation] CR8-1 — describeTool deletion range overstates the block
File: `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket03-spec-r8.md:96` (also T2 `:132`, §9 `:169`, §10 C1 `:218`)
Confidence: HIGH
Issue: The clause says delete `tools.go:682-691` (§10 says `:683-691`), but the target+commit block is `:682-688`; `:689-691` are `contributeOperation`, `if t.logger != nil`, `duration :=` — which the same clause designates as the retained success path starting `:689`. A literal range deletion removes the logging prologue and breaks compilation.
Fix: cite `:682-688` (and `:683-688` in §10/§9); advisory only — the explicit `:689` boundary already makes the intended edit unambiguous.

### Open Questions (non-blocking, informational)
[MEDIUM] Publication subtest exercises only the runtime-accept half of publication
File: candidate `AC7(iv)`, T2(iii)
Confidence: HIGH on code fact
Issue: `runtime.Reload` (`reload.go:479`) only calls `accept` (generation/pointer swap, `projection.go:150-172`); production reload additionally calls `ToolSurface.Published`, which rebases every live owner (`projection.go:907-985`). The "ZERO projection/interest/union/registry mutation" clause is therefore satisfiable only for the specified harness. The oracle still fails RED without the late check, so this is representativeness, not falsifiability. Consider stating the harness covers the accept half explicitly.

- r8 repairs are surgical: seam and baseline changes are propagated uniformly to every dependent clause (AD11, §4, AC7, T2, §9), with no stale r7 wording left.
- CR7-2 correctly diagnoses that the retirement's own mutation invalidated the baseline, and keeps the publication subtest unchanged rather than weakening both.
- Anchor discipline is now high: all CR7-3 and enumerated count anchors resolve exactly against the working tree.

APPROVE
